summaries.en: croc is a command-line tool for securely transferring files between two computers, solving the friction of sending large files without cloud storage or USB drives. It uses PAKE (Password Authenticated Key Exchange) to establish an end-to-end encrypted connection via a relay server, ensuring simplicity and security. To use, just run 'croc send <file>' on one machine and 'croc <code>' on the other. Great for ad-hoc transfers across networks where FTP or scp feel cumbersome.

summaries.en: Hyprland is a dynamic tiling Wayland compositor designed for users who want both productivity and aesthetics. It combines automatic window management with deep configurability through plain text configuration files, allowing fine-grained control over layouts, animations, and visual effects. Technically, it achieves smooth rendering by leveraging modern GPU features and efficient resource management. Developers and power users can extend it via plugins or customize every aspect of the desktop experience. Ideal for those who want a visually stunning, keyboard-driven workflow on Linux.
summaries.zh: Hyprland 是一款面向注重效率与美感的用户的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器。它通过简洁的文本配置文件实现深度自定义，让用户自由调整窗口布局、动画效果和视觉样式，兼顾自动平铺的便捷与桌面的美观。技术上，它利用现代 GPU 特性实现流畅渲染，并保持资源占用高效。开发者可通过插件扩展其功能，普通用户也能轻松调出心仪的视觉风格。无论你是追求极致的键盘工作流，还是希望桌面既好看又好用，Hyprland 都提供了理想的解决方案。

summaries.en: Outlines is a Python library that forces LLMs to generate structured outputs like JSON, regex, or CFG, solving the problem of unreliable free-text responses. It uses constrained decoding or grammar-based guidance to shape token probabilities during generation, ensuring outputs strictly follow a predefined schema. You can integrate it with any LLM via a simple API: define your output structure (e.g., a Pydantic model) and call outlines.generate — useful for building reliable data extraction pipelines, API backends, or tool-using agents.
summaries.zh: Outlines 是一个让LLM生成结构化输出的Python库，解决大模型输出不可控、难以解析的痛点。它通过约束解码或语法引导技术，在生成时动态调整token概率，确保输出严格遵循预定义格式（如JSON、正则表达式或上下文无关文法）。使用极简：只需定义输出结构（例如Pydantic模型），调用 outlines.generate 即可获得符合规则的结果。这一能力特别适合构建可靠的数据抽取管道、API后端或需要精确工具调用的智能体——无需后处理或多次提示，一次生成即可直接使用。

summaries.en: Cloudflare_temp_email is a free temporary domain email service that protects your privacy by providing disposable email addresses. It leverages Cloudflare Workers and Pages for serverless deployment, making it easy to set up without managing your own infrastructure. Technically, it supports attachments, IMAP, SMTP, and Telegram bot integration, offering flexible ways to send and receive emails. You can deploy it on your own Cloudflare account, customize the domain, and use Telegram to receive notifications—ideal for account sign-ups or spam filtering.
summaries.zh: cloudflare_temp_email 是一个基于 Cloudflare 的免费临时域名邮箱服务，专为保护隐私而生，提供一次性邮箱地址以防垃圾邮件。它利用 Cloudflare Workers 和 Pages 实现无服务器部署，无需自建服务器即可运行。技术亮点在于支持附件、IMAP、SMTP 以及 Telegram Bot 集成，让收发邮件方式更灵活。你可以轻松部署到自己的 Cloudflare 账户，自定义域名，并通过 Telegram 实时接收邮件通知。非常适合用于网站注册验证、临时收信或隐私保护场景。

summaries.en: Pumpkin is a high-performance Minecraft Bedrock Edition server written in Rust, designed to make hosting fast and efficient servers accessible to everyone. Its core strength lies in Rust's memory safety and zero-cost abstractions, enabling high concurrency and low resource usage even for large player counts. You can quickly deploy Pumpkin using Docker or compile it from source, then customize it with plugins or direct protocol modifications for your community.
summaries.zh: Pumpkin 是一个用 Rust 开发的高性能 Minecraft Bedrock 版服务器，旨在让每个人都能轻松托管快速、高效的服务器。其核心优势在于 Rust 语言的内存安全和零成本抽象，使得即便在高玩家并发下也能保持低资源消耗和高吞吐量。你可以通过 Docker 快速部署，或从源码编译，并利用插件系统或直接修改协议来定制服务器功能，非常适合需要稳定、低延迟体验的社区或模组服务器。

summaries.en: i-have-adhd is a skill plugin for coding agents like Claude that ensures answers are delivered concisely and upfront, solving the problem of verbose or buried responses. It works by intercepting the agent's output and reformatting it to highlight the key answer first, reducing cognitive load. Practical use: attach this skill to your coding assistant for instant, actionable answers without scrolling through irrelevant details, ideal for quick debugging or code lookups.
summaries.zh: i-have-adhd 是一个为编程助手（如Claude）设计的技能插件，能强制助手输出简洁直接的回答，避免冗长或隐藏答案的问题。其原理是拦截助手的输出，过滤掉无关内容，将关键答案前置显示，从而减轻用户的阅读负担。实际使用时，只需将此技能附加到你的编程助手，就能在调试或查询代码时立即获得所需答案，无需浏览多余信息，特别适合注意力不易集中的开发者提升效率。

summaries.en: pi-web is a web-based user interface for the pi coding agent, making it easy for developers to interact with an AI assistant for code generation and debugging directly in the browser. Built with TypeScript, it offers a clean, responsive design that mirrors terminal-like interactions. You can run it locally to experiment with the pi agent or integrate it into your development workflow without switching contexts. Ideal for rapid prototyping and learning how LLM-driven coding agents work in practice.
summaries.zh: pi-web 是为 pi 编码代理提供的 Web 用户界面，让开发者能够通过浏览器直接与 AI 助手交互，进行代码生成与调试操作。项目采用 TypeScript 构建，界面简洁、响应式，模拟终端的交互方式。你可以将其本地部署，快速体验 pi 代理的能力，或将其嵌入现有开发流程，无需频繁切换上下文。这一设计降低了 AI 编码代理的使用门槛，特别适合快速原型设计。通过观察代理与代码的交互，你还能深入理解大语言模型驱动的编码工具的实际工作机制，是学习和实验 LLM 应用的不错起点。
